title: Awake in Mallworld in the elevator.
content: I was trying to get to a certain floor and I went in the elevator and the floor I needed wasn’t on the button panel so I got out and tried to call another elevator and while standing in the hallway I finally had a lucid moment. I turned to the person I was supposed to be escorted and exclaimed oh, I’m asleep and dreaming and this is Mallworld. You know the elevators here are always glitchy and wonky here! I was in large multi room and multi floor building that was NOT a portal house. It was supposed to be a royal residence of some kind. The next time I got in the elevator it had different controls and I was able to get to the floor I needed with no problem so of course I got lost back in the dreaming.
